_about: Reviewed supplementary items for Section 1. The Ques document contains a single distinct question for each verbal and non-series reasoning topic (repeated 30 times), so these items give those topics a real pool. Finance items support the BFSI 'financial or analytical sections' step in the research document.

Passage: "Many teams adopt microservices expecting instant speed. In practice, splitting a system too early multiplies deployments, network calls and failure points. Teams that succeed usually start with a well-structured monolith, identify boundaries that change independently, and only then extract services with clear ownership and automated testing." What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Microservices help only when introduced deliberately after clear boundaries emerge.
Automated testing is unnecessary for services.
mcq.answer: Microservices help only when introduced deliberately after clear boundaries emerge.

mcq.q: Passage: "Many teams adopt microservices expecting instant speed. In practice, splitting a system too early multiplies deployments, network calls and failure points. Teams that succeed usually start with a well-structured monolith, identify boundaries that change independently, and only then extract services with clear ownership and automated testing." According to the passage, what does splitting a system too early increase?
options: Deployments, network calls and failure points
mcq.answer: Deployments, network calls and failure points

mcq.q: Passage: "Research on productive teams repeatedly finds that psychological safety — the belief that one will not be punished for speaking up — predicts performance better than individual brilliance. When members feel safe, they report mistakes early, ask questions and challenge assumptions, which prevents small problems from becoming expensive failures." Why does psychological safety improve performance, according to the passage?
options: Problems are raised early, before they become costly.
It replaces the need for skilled individuals.
mcq.answer: Problems are raised early, before they become costly.

mcq.q: Passage: "Research on productive teams repeatedly finds that psychological safety — the belief that one will not be punished for speaking up — predicts performance better than individual brilliance. When members feel safe, they report mistakes early, ask questions and challenge assumptions, which prevents small problems from becoming expensive failures." Which statement can be inferred from the passage?
options: A team of capable people who speak up may outperform a team of silent experts.
Individual brilliance has no effect on performance.
Mistakes should be hidden to protect morale.
mcq.answer: A team of capable people who speak up may outperform a team of silent experts.

The environmental benefit of electric vehicles depends mainly on:
options: the source of the electricity used to charge them
mcq.answer: the source of the electricity used to charge them

Pointing to a man, Riya says, "He is the son of my grandfather's only son." How is the man related to Riya?
mcq.explanation: Her grandfather's only son is her father, so his son is her brother.

Five friends A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. C sits in the middle. A sits immediately to the left of C. E sits at the right end. B does not sit next to A. Who sits at the left end?
mcq.explanation: C is 3rd, A 2nd, E 5th. B cannot be 1st (next to A), so B is 4th and D is 1st.

mcq.explanation: At sunset the sun is in the west, so shadows point east. East on his left means he faces south.
